question: What claim about the root Kaula tradition requires eight factors of siddhi-attainment to be addressed to one of fair face?
premises: Eight elements are counted in this context.
A connective links those elements to a stated attainment.
The root Kaula attainment is presented as the object addressed here.
inference: The eightfold siddhi-attainment of the root Kaula is directly addressed to the fair-faced one.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight elements remains unclear from this verse alone.
plain_english: And eight, O fair-faced one, are the siddhi-attainments of the root Kaula.
